description: This file defines the LocaleTranslation class, which implements translation functionalities for the Drupal locale module, including string translation, caching, and dependency management.

classes.name: LocaleTranslation
classes.description: A class providing translation services using locale's string storage and caching, implementing TranslatorInterface and DestructableInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the translation service with storage, cache, lock, config, language manager, and request stack dependencies.

methods.name: getStringTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves the translation for a given string in a specified language and context, utilizing caching and lookup objects.

methods.name: canTranslateEnglish
methods.description: Checks whether English translation is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the translation cache and related settings.

methods.name: destruct
methods.description: Performs cleanup by destructing lookup objects if they implement DestructableInterface.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares the object for serialization, excluding non-serializable properties.
